reviews.text: Highly recommend!!
Welcome to the Riverside family!  We appreciate the trust you have placed in us to care for your beautiful pup Leo.

We have had such a wonderful experience with Riverside Veterinary Care on Columbus Avenue, especially during West’s first couple of visits. From the moment we walked in, everyone has been incredibly sweet, kind, patient, and genuinely caring.

West is a very young puppy and, as you can imagine, she can be quite a handful! The entire team has been so patient with her and has made every visit feel comfortable and positive. They take their time, handle her gently, answer all of our questions, and never make us feel rushed.

What has stood out to us most is how genuinely caring the staff has been toward West. You can tell they truly love animals and want both the pets and their owners to feel comfortable. As new puppy parents, having a veterinary team we can trust means so much to us.

We are so happy we found Riverside Veterinary Care and feel very confident knowing West is in such caring hands. Thank you to the entire team for taking such wonderful care of our little girl! We highly recommend Riverside to anyone looking for a kind, compassionate, and attentive veterinary practice. ❤️🐾
Absolutely extraordinary team. Could not dream of a better vet office.
Always a great experience! They take great care of my cat every time.
Excellent first visit with my 15-lb skittish dog. Caring staff, not rushed, extremely clean facility.
My catshad an amazing visit and the team took a lot of care of her which was surprisingly because she’s a monster at the vet

Great Vets, lovely support staff, beautiful new office on Columbus across from MNH.
Not overpriced!
very professional, courteous and staff is amazing, and you will leave  knowing that your pet is well looked after.
Great first experience; very friendly staff from front desk to the vet. Caring and thoughtful vet.
Been their client for over 15 years. The vets there are the best! They care for us as we are family.

Dr Ball was caring, patient and thorough.  Leo, our cat, took to her immediately, as did we.   We all enjoyed and appreciated our visit to Riverside Veterinary Care. Rachael welcomed us welcomed us warmly. We have been coming for five years and we are so grateful to all who have attended to Leo over the years.  Thank you RVC!
My cat Tom had his teeth cleaned under anesthesia. Everything went perfectly.

Love the staff - both support and the doctors. They all really seem to care about my girl which to me is everything. Never feel rushed or like I'm intruding like I have at other Vets in the area. I recommend them wholeheartedly!

bThey are superb vets and very thoughtful and attentive.  The staff is also incredibly helpful and responsive.  They also follow up after each appointment to see how my pet is doing and if I have any questions.

I cannot say enough about how lovely everyone at Riverside Vet was. From the front desk, to the techs, to Dr Ball, the visit was so stress free for both myself and my dog. As a first time dog parent, I can’t recommend them enough. I felt very supported and listened to and Dr Ball took the time to answer all of my questions and go over how we would approach ongoing care as he grows. Fantastic experience.

I've been taking my cats to Riverside for more than 25 years. I started going to their original location on West 79th Street between Broadway and Amsterdam, and they've since moved to a beautiful, spacious new location nearby on Columbus Avenue between 80th and 81st.
The entire staff is caring and responsible, and they always attend to my pets' every need. They consistently go out of their way to help us. Dr. Ratcliff and Dr. Ball are wonderful!

Two years ago, Dr. Ratcliff diagnosed the bowel problem that plagued one of our cats (and the rest of us!).  Her treatment plan has kept him in great health, all this time.  Dr. Ratcliff has also expertly managed less mysterious -- but serious -- problems in each of our two other cats.  I trust her to treat my cats as thoughtfully as I'd hope for a physician to treat me or a human family member.  I've had less contact with other vets at Riverside, but all of them have been wonderful, too.  And, great, knowledgeable, efficient techs and support staff!   ** Update, July 2026: now caring expertly for a cat with kidney disease.   Best veterinary practice I have ever known.

My little Macho Chihuahua is not the easiest guy to handle!! But everyone loved him just the way he is!
Great experience, very professional and organized

Thank you to all of you

Each time I visited here, the vets impressed me. They treated me and my cat very well, listened to my description and responded clearly and rationally. I trust them and like the way the staff and the vets treated us.

Orna, thank you for chosing us to be your veterarian for all of these years! Our relationship with you means so much to all of us, and we’re truly grateful for the trust you’ve placed in our team. Please know that we’re always here for you, whenever you need us.
Very kind. Patients, caring
Thank you so much for being a part of the Riverside family! We truly appreciate your support and the opportunity to care for Lily. Please give her a big hug from the Riverside team!

My husband and I are very thankful we brought our new puppy here. The care, attention and affection she has received across the board from everyone with whom we have interacted has been wonderful. Excellent veterinary care and super-responsive staff. Highly recommend, especially with their fear-free approach!
Dr. Ball and the technicians were patient with our anxious Coco. We found a great new vet for him!
Would never take my pup anywhere else!!
The doctor and her staff were so helpful. They helped me navigate a stressful situation with my cat. Very patient, understanding, and knowledgeable.
Excellent service. Realistic prices.
Thank you for sharing Nicole! We are glad you had a good experience with us
Whole experience was perfect. Doctor was very knowledgeable and helpful with my questions. Highly recommended!

Lucius was comfortable, the receptionist remembered him. The new location is ample easy to get to and very clean. Our visit was prompt, informative, and affordable. We both left happy and would recommend to anyone living in the west side. We actually come from the Bronx, but Lucius has been cared for all his life at Riverside,
Thank you for your positive feedback, Joanna. We appreciate your review!
This has been my veterinarian location for years.  They are caring and knowledgeable and their office is very friendly as much helps the animals be calm.
Thanks for your feedback and welcome to Riverside Veterinary Care!  We hope you and Luna have a wonderful trip!
The Riverside team is truly the BEST. Cannot speak more highly of them. I have a dog that is very scared at the vet and they make so many accommodations for us. Can't imagine going anywhere else
My dog loves it here! A bit pricey but that comes with the location I think

We always receive a very warm, caring and personal service. Everyone in the clinic are nice and welcoming, from the front desk to the vet. It is a stress free environment, and the vet took the time to throughly explain us about a medical procedure we were thinking of. We really appreciate the care of everyone in the clinic, and how it is stress free for us and for our Pet, as we know he is in good hands.

This was my very first vet visit as a first‑time dog parent, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I went with Lorenzo and was honestly nervous, worried I might be doing something wrong, but the entire team made me feel calm and supported from the moment I walked in. Everyone was incredibly kind to both of us. They explained every step clearly, never rushed anything, and were so patient and gentle with him during the vaccines and the blood test. I left feeling informed and grateful. It’s such a relief to have found a place where I feel guided and where Lorenzo is treated with so much care!
A wonderful experience, the whole team very kind, professional and efficient as always. Thank you very much for your generous help.

I brought my newest “family member”, Cannoli to see Dr. Elizabeth Ball. Dr. Ball put us all at ease during visit. Dr. Ball was thoughtful, knowledgeable and very helpful. I am recommending Dr. Ball to my other family members for their pets.

Had a great experience! They were incredibly thorough and attentive, taking the time to make sure everything was done right while also being gentle and patient. You can really tell they care about pets and their comfort. Highly recommend!

My dog Softie has been a patient at Riverside Veterinary Clinic since our very first days in the U.S., and our experience over the past two years has been truly exceptional.

From the convenient location and spotless interior to the warm and welcoming reception team, everything about this clinic feels professional and caring. The doctors are highly qualified, attentive, and genuinely dedicated to their patients. Softie received all of his vaccinations there, and the clinic consistently followed up afterward to check on his wellbeing and stay in touch, which always meant a lot to me.

In urgent situations, the doctors were incredibly helpful over the phone and, most importantly, they were able to identify the underlying cause of my dog’s chronic coughing — something that had not been properly diagnosed since his birth. His dental procedure also went smoothly, and he was clearly well cared for throughout the entire process.

When we needed travel documentation for moving abroad, the team handled everything efficiently and made the process completely stress-free.

A special thank you to Rachel — she is incredibly kind, attentive, and a true professional. I am deeply grateful for the care and dedication the entire team has shown to Softie.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care. Our experience over these two years in New York has been nothing short of perfect.
Melissa, thank you for sharing your positive experience and welcome to  Riverside Veterinary Care on Columbus!  It was great meeting you and Lucca.
The staff was professional and kind.  I was very happy with the services that were provided to my pup.

I was bracing for exorbitant costs for a routine mature lady cat checkup.  Dr Ball was really nice, patient, and reasonable.  She is also a very good educator and I think all pet parents would benefit from all her helpful advice and care.  The staff, as usual, were kind and friendly.  I was quite pleased with the appointment.  The experience made me want to come back and have Dr Ball keep taking care of Mochi to provide the best quality of life for the cat.  Thank you!
The best staff and care for our furry friends ❤️
Thank you Andy!  Please give Maple a hug from all of us at Riverside Veterinary Care!
LOVE THESE PEOPLE.  THEY CARE ABOUT OUR PETS AND THEY ARE COMPLETELY ACCESSIBLE. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Dr. Ratcliff is excellent and provided thorough care.

Over the course of one month, I saw two other vets at this clinic for exams and blood work, but significant findings were missed. When I took my cat to an animal ER and soon she was diagnosed with cancer, and the veterinarian in the hospital was able to palpate tumors in her back legs.

The staff is kind, but accurate diagnosis requires careful examination.

Dr. Ratcliff and the staff at Riverside Vet Care are absolutely incredible.  I highly recommend them for your pet!  I have two medically-challenging cats, and Dr. Ratcliff has gone above and beyond to brainstorm, test, and discover the best ways to treat their complex issues.  The office is very clean and has a separate cat waiting room in the back.  The staff is very responsive both by phone and email.  When I needed to take one of my cats to Blue Pearl in an emergency, RVCOC immediately sent my cat’s records and followed up with Blue Pearl directly to get all the information they needed to treat him after he came home.  They also recommended an at-home service to come check my cat’s blood pressure because the trips to the vet are so tough for him.  They have always been upfront with me about cost - no surprises, although I know that can happen sometimes.  After the past few years, I now trust Dr. Ratcliff implicitly and look forward to continuing my cats’ care with her!
